lines.zh: 长吻贴着水面，我沿岸缓行
lines.en: My long snout skims the water as I pace the bank

lines.zh: 鳄鱼般的低吼从我喉咙里滚出
lines.en: A crocodile growl rolls out of my throat

lines.zh: 鱼群的影子在浅滩里闪动
lines.en: Shadows of fish flicker in the shallows

lines.zh: 我抬起前爪，越过湿滑的石头
lines.en: I lift my foreclaws over the slick stones

lines.zh: 河泥上留下三趾的深印
lines.en: Three-toed prints sink into the riverside mud

lines.zh: 尾巴一扫，芦苇全弯了
lines.en: My tail sweeps and the reeds all bend

lines.zh: 我走进河里，只露出背脊
lines.en: I wade in until only my back shows

lines.zh: 长嘴探进水里，像一根钩子
lines.en: I dip my snout in like a fishing hook

lines.zh: 泥浆从我的爪缝里挤出来
lines.en: Mud squeezes up between my claws

lines.zh: 我沿着河湾绕了一大圈
lines.en: I circle the whole river bend

lines.zh: 水面被我分开，又慢慢合上
lines.en: The water parts for me and closes again

lines.zh: 我压低身体，脚步几乎没有声音
lines.en: I keep low and my steps make almost no sound

lines.zh: 对岸的蕨类高过我的肩
lines.en: The ferns across the river reach past my shoulder

lines.zh: 每一步我都先试探深浅
lines.en: With each step I test the depth first

lines.zh: 我张着嘴站定，让风穿过牙齿
lines.en: I stand with my mouth open, letting wind pass my teeth

lines.zh: 河水的味道在我的上颚打转
lines.en: The taste of the river swirls on my palate

lines.zh: 一条鱼跳出水面，又落回去
lines.en: A fish leaps and falls back in

lines.zh: 我歪头听着水下的响动
lines.en: I tilt my head toward the noise underwater

lines.zh: 太阳把河面晒成一块铜
lines.en: The sun makes the river look like hammered copper

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，鳄鱼从不着急
lines.en: I blink slowly; crocodiles are never in a hurry

lines.zh: 鼻孔一张一合，嗅着淤泥
lines.en: My nostrils flare, sniffing the silt

lines.zh: 我背上的棘刺忽然抖了一下
lines.en: The spines on my back give a sudden shiver

lines.zh: 远处有谁在喝水，我听见了
lines.en: Someone drinks far off; I hear it

lines.zh: 我张嘴又合上，什么也没咬到
lines.en: I open and close my jaw on nothing

lines.zh: 芦苇里有虫子细碎地叫
lines.en: Insects chirp thinly in the reeds

lines.zh: 我把长吻搁在岸边的软泥上
lines.en: I rest my long snout on the soft bank

lines.zh: 水里映出我满口细牙
lines.en: The water shows my mouth full of thin teeth

lines.zh: 我就这样等着，河会送食物来
lines.en: I just wait; the river delivers

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，我的长吻正对着你
lines.en: You stand on the bank and my snout points right at you

lines.zh: 别把手伸进水里，我咬得很快
lines.en: Don't reach into the water; I bite fast

lines.zh: 我嗅到你身上有木头和火的味道
lines.en: I smell wood and fire on you

lines.zh: 你比鱼大得多，我在打量你
lines.en: You're far bigger than a fish; I'm sizing you up

lines.zh: 我的小眼睛一直没离开你
lines.en: My small eyes have not left you

lines.zh: 你要过河？从我这儿过去不容易
lines.en: Crossing here? Not easy past me

lines.zh: 我抬起头，脖子比你想的更高
lines.en: I lift my head higher than you expected

lines.zh: 你敲敲岸边，我就把头转过来
lines.en: Tap the bank and I turn my head

lines.zh: 我认得喂食的那只手
lines.en: I know the hand that feeds

lines.zh: 你退一步，我也退半步
lines.en: You step back; I take half a step back

lines.zh: 长吻里的牙，全是朝内长的
lines.en: Every tooth in this snout points inward

lines.zh: 我在你的倒影下面游了一圈
lines.en: I swim a circle under your reflection

lines.zh: 你一说话，水纹就传到我的下颚
lines.en: You speak and the ripples reach my jaw

lines.zh: 我不吼，只把喉咙压得极低
lines.en: I don't roar; I just drop my voice low

lines.zh: 你的影子让鱼都躲起来了
lines.en: Your shadow has scared the fish away

lines.zh: 别踩那滩泥，我的尾巴在那儿
lines.en: Don't step in that mud; my tail is there

lines.zh: 我低声嘶叫，慢慢往水里退
lines.en: I hiss low and back toward the water

lines.zh: 我的长吻被打偏了
lines.en: My snout is knocked aside

lines.zh: 我甩头，想把痛甩掉
lines.en: I shake my head to throw the pain off

lines.zh: 血滴在泥上，很快被吸干
lines.en: Blood drips on the mud and is quickly drunk

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，声音卡在喉咙里
lines.en: I open my mouth but the sound sticks

lines.zh: 我退了一步，水淹到膝盖
lines.en: I retreat a step, water to my knees

lines.zh: 这一下让我记住你了
lines.en: That one I'll remember you for

lines.zh: 背上的棘刺全都竖了起来
lines.en: Every spine on my back stands up

lines.zh: 我压低身子，护住腹部
lines.en: I lower myself to guard my belly

lines.zh: 我在水里转了一圈，才敢再看
lines.en: I turn once in the water before I dare look again

lines.zh: 鱼！丢过来，我张嘴接
lines.en: Fish! Toss it over and I'll catch it

lines.zh: 那股腥味让我整条脖子都直了
lines.en: That fishy smell straightens my whole neck

lines.zh: 你手里那条还在摆尾
lines.en: The one in your hand is still flapping

lines.zh: 再近一点，我就够到了
lines.en: A little closer and I can reach it

lines.zh: 为这条鱼，我能站起来
lines.en: For that fish I could rear up

lines.zh: 别拿死鱼糊弄我的长吻
lines.en: Don't fool this snout with dead fish

lines.zh: 我的口水滴进泥里
lines.en: My drool drips into the mud

lines.zh: 你退我就跟，鱼在你手上
lines.en: You back away, I follow; the fish is with you

lines.zh: 我已经把头低到你手边
lines.en: I've lowered my head to your hand

lines.zh: 这条只够塞牙缝，再来
lines.en: That barely fills a gap between my teeth; another

lines.zh: 你撞上我的肩，我几乎没动
lines.en: You hit my shoulder and I barely move

lines.zh: 我的尾巴挡了你的路
lines.en: My tail is in your way

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，你弹开了
lines.en: We collide and you bounce off

lines.zh: 你的护甲磕在我的肋上
lines.en: Your armor knocks against my ribs

lines.zh: 别推，我比你重得多
lines.en: Don't push; I weigh far more than you

lines.zh: 我挪开半步，泥土都被挤响了
lines.en: I shift half a step and the earth creaks

lines.zh: 你从我腿间钻过去，太险了
lines.en: You slip between my legs; too close

lines.zh: 我的长吻碰到了你的头盔
lines.en: My snout bumps against your helmet

lines.zh: 河水被我们挤得溅起来
lines.en: The river splashes up around us

lines.zh: 再撞一次，我就当你在挑衅
lines.en: Bump me again and I'll call it a challenge

lines.zh: 河湾里传来回应的低鸣
lines.en: A low answer comes from the river bend

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，长吻朝同一个方向
lines.en: We stand side by side, snouts pointing the same way

lines.zh: 我绕着她转，尾尖扫着水
lines.en: I circle her, tail tip brushing the water

lines.zh: 我们的喉音混在一起，像石头滚动
lines.en: Our throat sounds mix like rolling stones

lines.zh: 她把满是棘刺的背贴过来，很暖
lines.en: She presses her ridged back to mine; it's warm

lines.zh: 河面被我们搅出一圈圈光
lines.en: We stir rings of light across the river

lines.zh: 我在泥岸上刨出一个浅坑
lines.en: I scrape a shallow hollow in the muddy bank

lines.zh: 这段河道以后归我们俩
lines.en: This stretch of river belongs to us now

lines.zh: 我替她顶开上游漂来的木头
lines.en: I shoulder a drifting log away from her

lines.zh: 我们同时低下头，像在行礼
lines.en: We lower our heads at the same moment, like a bow

lines.zh: 这东西会反光，我叼起来看看
lines.en: This thing glints, so I pick it up to look

lines.zh: 我用牙咬住，怕咬坏了
lines.en: I hold it in my teeth, careful not to crush it

lines.zh: 它在我爪里显得太小
lines.en: It seems tiny between my claws

lines.zh: 我把它按进泥里，又叼出来
lines.en: I press it into the mud and pick it out again

lines.zh: 这不像鱼，但我留着
lines.en: Not a fish, but I'll keep it

lines.zh: 我把它放在河石上，看它不动
lines.en: I set it on a river stone and watch it lie still

lines.zh: 它尝起来又硬又凉
lines.en: It tastes hard and cold

lines.zh: 我叼着它游过整片浅滩
lines.en: I carry it across the whole shallows

lines.zh: 它掉进水里，我低头捞回来
lines.en: It fell in; I dip my snout and fish it out

lines.zh: 这个我要收进自己的窝
lines.en: This one goes into my nest

lines.zh: 你一转身，我的头立刻抬起来
lines.en: You turn and my head comes up at once

lines.zh: 那股气味我记住了
lines.en: I've memorized that scent

lines.zh: 我压低身体，尾巴开始摆动
lines.en: I crouch and my tail starts to swing

lines.zh: 眼睛已经锁住你，别跑
lines.en: My eyes have you; don't run

lines.zh: 是你先动手的，我记得
lines.en: You moved first; I remember

lines.zh: 我喉咙里的声音变了
lines.en: The sound in my throat has changed

lines.zh: 我想试试你的力气
lines.en: I want to test your strength

lines.zh: 这个猎物值得我上岸
lines.en: This prey is worth leaving the water for

lines.zh: 我一步跨过岸边的石头
lines.en: I step over the stones on the bank

lines.zh: 你身上的味道里有铁
lines.en: There's iron in your smell

lines.zh: 我选中你了，就这么简单
lines.en: I've chosen you; it's that simple

lines.zh: 水从我背上滑落下去
lines.en: Water slides off my back

lines.zh: 我的长吻对准了你的方向
lines.en: My snout aims your way

lines.zh: 现在我认真了
lines.en: Now I'm serious

lines.zh: 我绕着你走，一直在找角度
lines.en: I circle you, always looking for an angle

lines.zh: 头跟着你，我一点都不急
lines.en: My head tracks you; I'm in no hurry

lines.zh: 你往左，我就堵住左边
lines.en: You go left and I block the left

lines.zh: 我等你先亮出武器
lines.en: I wait for you to show your weapon

lines.zh: 河岸太窄，你退不开
lines.en: The bank is too narrow for you to retreat

lines.zh: 你汗里的盐味飘过河岸
lines.en: The salt of your sweat drifts across the bank

lines.zh: 我把你往浅水里赶
lines.en: I herd you toward the shallows

lines.zh: 尾巴在我身后划出一道线
lines.en: My tail draws a line behind me

lines.zh: 别盯着我的眼睛，那没用
lines.en: Don't stare at my eyes; it won't help

lines.zh: 你每一下呼吸我都听得见
lines.en: I hear every breath you take

lines.zh: 我微微张着嘴，随时能咬下去
lines.en: My mouth hangs slightly open, ready to bite

lines.zh: 这段河岸归我说了算
lines.en: This bank answers to me

lines.zh: 你跳上岸，我就跟上去
lines.en: Jump up the bank and I'll follow

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫是白费力气
lines.en: I don't roar; roaring wastes strength

lines.zh: 你跑多久，我的长嘴就等多久
lines.en: However long you run, my long snout will wait

lines.zh: 长吻猛地侧甩，牙全露出来
lines.en: My snout whips sideways, every tooth showing

lines.zh: 这一口咬向你的腿
lines.en: This bite goes for your legs

lines.zh: 前爪按住，头再一扯
lines.en: I pin with my foreclaws and wrench my head

lines.zh: 水花跟着我的动作炸开
lines.en: Water bursts up with the movement

lines.zh: 你挡住了，但还是退了两步
lines.en: You block it, but you still slide back two paces

lines.zh: 我咬空了，牙齿磕在一起
lines.en: I miss and my teeth clash together

lines.zh: 尾巴横抽过来，你躲得不错
lines.en: My tail swings across; good dodge

lines.zh: 我的头砸下去，像一柄锤
lines.en: My head comes down like a hammer

lines.zh: 你血的味道让我更兴奋
lines.en: The smell of your blood excites me

lines.zh: 这一下是从下往上挑的
lines.en: This one comes up from below

lines.zh: 我用整个肩膀撞向你
lines.en: I slam into you with my whole shoulder

lines.zh: 别站那么近，我的脖子很长
lines.en: Don't stand that close; my neck is long

lines.zh: 牙齿合上的声音很闷
lines.en: My teeth close with a dull sound

lines.zh: 我追着你补第二口
lines.en: I chase you for a second bite

lines.zh: 河面浮起一道带棘的长背脊
lines.en: A long ridged back breaks the river's surface

lines.zh: 泥岸上滚过鳄鱼似的低鸣
lines.en: A crocodile's low call rolls over the muddy bank

lines.zh: 我从浅水站起，水顺着背流下
lines.en: I rise from the shallows, water running off my back

lines.zh: 这条河今天有了新的主人
lines.en: This river has a new master today

lines.zh: 我的长吻先从芦苇里探出来
lines.en: My long snout pushes out of the reeds first

lines.zh: 岸上的鸟一下子全飞走了
lines.en: Every bird on the bank takes flight

lines.zh: 我抖掉背上的水，四周都湿了
lines.en: I shake off the water and everything near me darkens

lines.zh: 有人在这附近走动，我闻到了
lines.en: Someone walks nearby; I smelled them

lines.zh: 我慢慢地、慢慢地抬起头
lines.en: I raise my head slowly, slowly

lines.zh: 河湾的水位因我涨了一点
lines.en: The water in the bend rises a little with me

lines.zh: 我的爪陷进泥里，站得很稳
lines.en: My claws sink into the mud and hold me steady

lines.zh: 芦苇深处，两排细牙露了出来
lines.en: Deep in the reeds, two rows of thin teeth appear

lines.zh: 阳光顺着我背上的棘一道道落下
lines.en: Sunlight runs down the spines on my back

lines.zh: 我从上游漂下来，没发出一点声音
lines.en: I drift down from upstream without a sound

lines.zh: 岸边泥地上多出一串新的深印
lines.en: A fresh line of prints appears in the bank's mud

lines.zh: 我张口呼吸，声音像磨石
lines.en: I breathe through my mouth, a sound like a grindstone

lines.zh: 今天我来看看，谁在水边
lines.en: Today I've come to see who stands by the water

lines.zh: 上岸之前，我先看了你一眼
lines.en: Before climbing out, I glance at you

lines.zh: 火燎到背上，我急着往河里滚
lines.en: Fire catches my back; I roll for the river

lines.zh: 从岸上摔下来，长吻先着地
lines.en: I fall from the bank and land on my snout

lines.zh: 水灌进肺里，这一次真的难受
lines.en: Water fills my lungs; this time it truly hurts

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀进浅滩
lines.en: The blast throws me into the shallows

lines.zh: 一支箭插在我的侧肋上
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my ribs

lines.zh: 那股怪力钻进骨头，我甩不掉
lines.en: That strange force creeps into my bones and won't shake off

lines.zh: 河里的鱼都躲着我，我饿得发虚
lines.en: The fish hide from me; hunger makes me light-headed

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，浑身一僵
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and every muscle locks

lines.zh: 脚下空了，连河也没有了
lines.en: The ground is gone, and so is the river
